title: platanthera montana
intro: Platanthera montana, commonly known as the alpine bog orchid, is a species of orchid that grows in the mountainous regions of North America. It is used in herbal medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, and its ability to aid in the treatment of respiratory issues and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Platanthera montana include its expectorant and anti-tussive effects, helping to relieve congestion and coughing. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
